data.title: Home contents insurance policy confirmation – Beispielschutz
data.summary: Beispielschutz Versicherung AG confirms a new home contents insurance (Hausratversicherung "Plus") policy for Bastian Musterquell covering the home at Quellenweg 7, starting 15 January 2027, with a sum insured of €65,000 and an annual premium of €96.60.
data.explanation: This letter confirms that your application for home contents insurance (Hausratversicherung) was accepted and your policy starts on 15 January 2027. No immediate action is required; keep this document for your records, as it proves your cover and premium. The contract runs for one year and renews automatically each year unless either side cancels in writing (Textform) at least three months before the end of an insurance year — the app will show you the relevant cancellation window if you want to end it. Check that the sum insured (€65,000) still matches the value of your belongings; if not, contact the insurer to adjust it.
